Cycle 67: Concord wins Transcendence. Final public UI: 5,493 credits (+191), 722 minerals (+79), 665 science (+116), 17/17 orders, 8 worlds, 12 discoveries, legacy 765. No rival broke its Concord trade treaty or attacked during cycles40–67. The entire ten-cycle alignment advanced uninterrupted. My reserve fleets were insurance never tested in combat.
